title: Why a valuation buffer matters

summary.text: Why a valuation buffer matters explains margin of safety for general learners. The explanation is limited to the supplied evidence.

key_points.text: A valuation buffer is a way to acknowledge estimation error, not a promise against loss.

evidence.title: Synthetic classroom note
evidence.content_summary: A valuation estimate depends on uncertain assumptions, so a gap between estimated value and price can absorb some mistakes without eliminating risk.
